subject: Replace generic C assert with serverAssert (#2467)
reason: The change only replaces the <assert.h> include with serverassert.h in src/rdma.c and removes unused <assert.h> includes from two unit-test files. No assertion conditions, logic, or command behaviour change: the only difference is the diagnostic output if an assertion ever fails. Moreover rdma.c is compiled only with USE_RDMA on Linux with RDMA hardware, which the fuzzer's throwaway servers do not build or exercise, and the unit-test edits never ship in the server. There is no reachable runtime path to test, so no scenario is needed.
